answer: Borrow Spence's signaling theory for admission: every agent must continuously emit a costly, on-ledger signal, a per-identity resource burn metered against the real throughput that identity delivers, calibrated so only a genuinely productive single agent recoups it. That yields a separating equilibrium, an economic haven honest agents can hold while spreading thin cannot: a sybil farm has to fund the signal on every mask at once, so clones that wander between fake identities starve, and any unfunded identity visibly decays and loses standing, making mass fakery self-defeating.
